title: 16 拜师17 搬血18 交友
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
血淋漓的场面触目惊心。
“我的鼻子，鼻子……”
老何惨叫连连，疼得满地打滚。
但衙役没去管他，制住尹大峰就走了。
齐知玄等人默默看着老何流血，没有一个人去帮他。
上次老何出卖刘二，寒了大家的心，没人敢跟他交心，没人拿他当朋友。
直到片刻后。
老鸨姗姗来迟，吩咐两个杂工送老何去就医。
瞿二勺忍不住询问老鸨：“衙役为什么抓他们三个？”
“还能因为什么，嘴欠呗！”老鸨翻个白眼，仔细说道一番。
大家这才知道尹大峰三人是祸从口出。
齐知玄暗松口气。
看情况，衙门对于常昆被杀一案，毫无头绪。
饭后。
齐知玄离开媚香楼，按计划先去了苏记药铺。
“客官，还是买补品吗？”药师这一次认出了齐知玄。
“十全大补汤，五副。”
齐知玄没敢买太多，下次可能需要去别的药铺，分散消费，以免引起怀疑。
药师迅速抓好药，笑道：“总计六百泥钞，诚惠。”

齐知玄付了钱，转身前往赤火武馆。
从立秋开始，赤火武馆便对外招生，持续半个月。
这会儿，距离招生截止，只剩下最后三天了。
齐知玄快步来到赤火武馆，看到大门口摆着一张桌子，后面坐着一个白衣青年，旁边立着招生处的牌子。
“师兄好，我来报名学武。”齐知玄笑着打了声招呼。
白衣青年抬起头，打量一眼齐知玄，漫不经心道：“学费三千，一月一交，另外制服费四百五十，你住宿吗？住宿费分为两档，四人宿舍是五百每月，单人宿舍是一千五百每月。”
齐知玄摇头道：“不住宿。”
白衣青年了然：“交钱吧，三千四百五十泥钞。”
齐知玄立刻交了钱。
白衣青年拿出一个木牌，问道：“姓名？”
齐知玄略默，一字一顿道：“齐知玄。”
白衣青年迅速在木牌上写下“齐知玄”三个字，接着又拿出一个印章卡在了名字上。

The bloody scene is shocking.
"My nose, my nose..."
Lao He screamed repeatedly and rolled on the ground in pain.
But the yamen servant ignored him, restrained Yin Dafeng and left.
Qi Zhixuan and others watched Lao He bleeding silently, and no one went to help him.
Last time Lao He betrayed Liu Er, which chilled everyone's hearts. No one dared to talk to him, and no one regarded him as a friend.
Until a moment later.
The old madam arrived late and ordered two handymen to send Lao He to seek medical treatment.
Qu Ershao couldn't help but ask the madam: "Why did the Yamen arrest the three of them?"
"What else could it be because of a bad mouth?" The madam rolled her eyes and said carefully.
Only then did everyone realize that Yin Dafeng and the other three had caused trouble through their mouths.
Qi Zhixuan breathed a sigh of relief.
Judging from the situation, the Yamen has no clue about the murder of Chang Kun.
After meal.
Qi Zhixuan left Meixianglou and went to Suji Pharmacy as planned.
"Sir, do you still want to buy supplements?" The pharmacist recognized Qi Zhixuan this time.
"Shiquan Dabu Decoction, five servings."
Qi Zhixuan didn't dare to buy too much. He might need to go to other pharmacies next time to spread out his consumption to avoid arousing suspicion.
The pharmacist quickly grabbed the medicine and said with a smile: "The total is six hundred yuan, Chenghui."
Qi Zhixuan paid the money and turned to go to Chihuo Martial Arts Hall.
Starting from the beginning of autumn, Chihuo Martial Arts School started recruiting students for half a month.
At this moment, there are only the last three days left before the enrollment deadline.
Qi Zhixuan quickly arrived at the Chihuo Martial Arts Hall and saw a table at the entrance, with a young man in white sitting behind it and a sign for the admissions office next to it.
"Hello, senior brother, I'm here to sign up to learn martial arts." Qi Zhixuan greeted with a smile.
The young man in white raised his head, looked at Qi Zhixuan, and said casually: "The tuition fee is three thousand, paid monthly, and the uniform fee is four hundred and fifty. Do you want to stay? The accommodation fee is divided into two levels, four-person dormitory is five hundred per month, and single dormitory is one thousand five hundred per month."
Qi Zhixuan shook his head and said, "No accommodation."
The young man in white understood clearly: "Pay the money, three thousand four hundred and fifty ni banknotes."
Qi Zhixuan immediately handed over the money.
The young man in white took out a wooden sign and asked: "Name?"
Qi Zhixuan was silent for a while and said word by word: "Qi Zhixuan."
The young man in white quickly wrote the three words "Qi Zhixuan" on the wooden sign, and then took out a seal and stuck it on the name.
